androidProviderReference.endpointDiscovery: BLE characteristic UUIDs are discovered from 0x2901 User Description descriptors; APP must address device-info/cloud-config by endpoint name and must not hardcode their characteristic UUIDs
androidProviderReference.capabilityRule: parse ESPDevice.getVersionInfo() raw JSON: Security/wifi capabilities are under prov, while cloud_prov is under nuwax; ESPDevice.getDeviceCapabilities() alone does not expose nuwax.cap
androidProviderReference.productionLoggingRequirement: use a vetted patched/forked library artifact, or verified R8 rules plus release artifact inspection, that removes raw QR and PoP Log.d output before production; an ordinary wrapper cannot suppress logging inside the library

transport.serviceNameFormat: PROV_ plus final three STA MAC bytes in uppercase hexadecimal
transport.activeAttemptGracePolicy: credentials accepted before the 300-second deadline receive one complete observation interval; completed failures do not extend the window
transport.osPairingPolicy: do not create an OS BLE pair/bond; protocomm Security 2 protects the provisioning application session
transport.bdAddressPolicy: scan-session locator only; never use BLE address as permanent device identity

wifiAssociation.transitionNetworkPolicy: during BLE provisioning, disable ESP-IDF WPA3 compatibility override so WPA2/WPA3 transition APs use the reliable WPA2 association path

security.usernameSource: device UID printed by development firmware; production QR or device label
security.proofOfPossessionSource: development fixed PoP from this contract or development QR; production per-device manufacturing label or authenticated credential service, not the identity-only device screen QR

onDeviceQrDisplay.payloadFormat: same Nuwax v1 provisioning JSON as qrPayloadExample
onDeviceQrDisplay.developmentBehavior: includes the configured development PoP for first-integration testing
onDeviceQrDisplay.productionBehavior: omits plaintext PoP because production firmware stores only salt and verifier
onDeviceQrDisplay.appIdentityCheck: after Security 2, device-info.serialNumber must equal QR username
onDeviceQrDisplay.returnAction: swipe right returns to Device detail

officialEndpoints.appValidationRule: require prov.sec_ver=2, prov.cap contains wifi_prov/wifi_scan, and nuwax.cap contains cloud_prov

customEndpointTransport.bleDiscovery: read each characteristic 0x2901 User Description descriptor after service discovery

appOrder: claim signed bundle from authenticated cloud API

bundle.signatureAlgorithm: ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256, DER signature encoded as base64
bundle.deviceIdentityRule: bundle.deviceId must equal device-info.serialNumber and hardware-derived device UID
bundle.bundleVersionRule: base-10 integer in range 1..9007199254740991 (JSON safe integer)
bundle.antiRollbackRule: bundleVersion must be greater than the newest stored version; exact idempotent replay is allowed

firmwareStorage.promoteCondition: authenticated hello from the signed target URL followed by successful device pending-to-active NVS commit
firmwareStorage.commitAcknowledgement: device sends cloud_config_committed with matching device_id and credential_id after the active slot is durable
firmwareStorage.commitRetryPolicy: current firmware sends cloud_config_committed once after local promotion; production must add idempotent resend until server acknowledgement/status convergence
firmwareStorage.failedPendingPolicy: discard immediately after explicit cloud rejection, or after three failed connection attempts when a previous active slot exists
firmwareStorage.productionRequirement: NVS Encryption + Flash Encryption + Secure Boot

urlPolicy.firstIntegration: signed ws:// or wss:// target; ws:// enabled only by test-build Kconfig
urlPolicy.production: signed wss:// target only with certificate verification

testGateway.claimAuth: Bearer APP login token; local test uses an ephemeral process token
testGateway.validatedScope: local per-device credential issuance, BLE delivery, device cloud authentication and credential commit only
testGateway.onlineStateDefinition: authenticated WebSocket is connected and the matching cloud_config_committed acknowledgement was accepted

successCriteria.cloudOnlineTimeoutScope: starts after WIFI_READY and BLE release; wait for matching DEVICE_ONLINE
successCriteria.reconnectStatusScope: while the 300-second provisioning window, an admitted active-attempt grace interval, or the 15-second post-success window remains active
successCriteria.appCompletionRule: report onboarding success only after WIFI_READY and DEVICE_ONLINE; CLOUD_CONFIG_COMMIT_PENDING remains a waiting state

failureMapping.authFailed: raw WIFI_EVENT_STA_DISCONNECTED auth-family reason, including WIFI_REASON_AUTH_EXPIRE, or NETWORK_PROV_WIFI_STA_AUTH_ERROR fallback

lifecycle.firstBootStartsProvisioning: when ESP-IDF Wi-Fi provisioned marker is absent
lifecycle.existingWifiWithoutCloudConfigPolicy: save current STA rollback record and automatically open reversible BLE cloud-recovery provisioning on boot
lifecycle.physicalEntryAction: open Device detail, scan Device QR first when needed, return to Device detail, then tap the visible Wi-Fi-icon BLE button below Meeting
lifecycle.physicalEntryFeedback: show BLE provisioning restart status, persist the current STA configuration as a rollback record, then reboot without erasing it
lifecycle.configuredDeviceAdvertisingPolicy: do not advertise provisioning BLE during normal boot
lifecycle.failedProvisioningKeepsBleConnected: yes, while the 300-second provisioning window or an admitted active-attempt grace interval remains active
lifecycle.resetCommandOrEndpoint: local Device menu Wi-Fi-icon BLE button only; no remote reset endpoint
lifecycle.postWindowFailureBehavior: after any admitted active attempt settles, stop BLE; a local rebind restores the previous Wi-Fi configuration, while first boot still requires a new provisioning window
